svg.text: Brindlewick Cricket Club, Hawthorn Lane, Brindlewick
Organised by Brindlewick Village Community Association.

g.data-flaw: Minor: the title is lighter than the original's bold, the italic beneficiary is set upright, and the rule between the attraction columns is lost.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: a bold wide grotesque in the corpus, and keeping thin rules out of the blanking.
